en-US.description: MComix is a user-friendly, customizable image viewer.
en-US.longDescription: MComix is a user-friendly, customizable image viewer. It is specifically designed to handle comic books (both Western comics and manga) and supports a variety of container formats (including CBR, CBZ, CB7, CBT, LHA and PDF). MComix is a fork of Comix.
en-US.name: MComix
